title: curriculum.promote request (v1.0)
description: Payload of `curriculum.promote` (payload_schema_version 1.0). Promotes a stored RECONCILED_CANDIDATE curriculum version to APPROVED_CANONICAL. The candidate manifest must hash to the stored manifest_sha256; the original manifest is the operator-supplied approved plan the candidate is reconciled against. Requires a reconciliation report whose promotion_allowed is true and an operator approval (Capability::CURRICULUM_PROMOTE).

candidate_manifest.description: The stored candidate manifest (verified against manifest_sha256).

original_manifest.description: The original approved plan supplied by the operator (data, never instructions).
